question.text: Since April 2019, when FATF's mandate was revised, what is the duration of the FATF President's term of office?

explanation.text: The Logic: The April 2019 revised mandate extended the FATF Presidency to a two-year period, with the term running from 1 July to 30 June two years later. The current FATF President is Elisa de Anda Madrazo of Mexico, serving from July 2024 to June 2026, confirming the 2-year term. The Trap: Options of 3 and 4 years are common distractors for leadership-term questions but do not apply to FATF. Note: Post-April-2019 FATF President term = 2 years.
